question: What is the primary characteristic of a polyvalent nurse?

options.A: Ability to work across multiple clinical specialties
options.C: Specialization in intensive care medicine only
options.D: Focus strictly on hospital administrative duties

explanation: A polyvalent nurse is trained to practice across various healthcare settings and specialties instead of remaining limited to one area. [learn more](GNS112_U1_T7#GNS112_U1_T7_h1)

question: Why is polyvalent nursing particularly useful in resource-limited health facilities?

options.A: It allows a smaller staff to cover diverse patient needs safely
options.B: It completely replaces the need for attending medical doctors
options.C: It reduces the salary budget of the hospital administration
options.D: It eliminates the need for any formal nursing documentation

explanation: Versatile nurses can shift between wards and departments to address immediate staffing gaps and varied patient loads. [learn more](GNS112_U1_T7#GNS112_U1_T7_h1)

question: Multi-skilling in nursing primarily involves mastering what?

options.A: Only advanced surgical theatre assisting techniques
options.C: A broad spectrum of practical and clinical abilities

explanation: Multi-skilling means the nurse possesses a wide range of competencies applicable to different types of patient care. [learn more](GNS112_U1_T7#GNS112_U1_T7_h2)

question: A nurse moves from the medical ward to the emergency unit and quickly sets up an IV infusion. This action demonstrates what quality?
explanation: Quickly performing essential clinical tasks in a new environment shows the versatile skill set of a polyvalent nurse. [learn more](GNS112_U1_T7#GNS112_U1_T7_h2)

question: How does adaptability help a nurse working in rural Nigerian health clinics?

options.A: It removes the necessity for keeping accurate patient records
options.B: It enables effective care delivery with limited material resources
options.C: It allows the nurse to avoid performing bedside nursing procedures
options.D: It guarantees an automatic promotion to hospital management

explanation: Adaptable nurses adjust their practice to suit available supplies while still maintaining safe and effective patient care standards. [learn more](GNS112_U1_T7#GNS112_U1_T7_h3)

question: Which setting is NOT typically part of the varied environments a polyvalent nurse might encounter?
explanation: Space station medical bays are outside the scope of standard local and international nursing deployment environments. [learn more](GNS112_U1_T7#GNS112_U1_T7_h3)

question: Why is clear communication critical for a polyvalent nurse?

options.A: To make sure doctors do all the direct patient education
options.B: To replace the need for written nursing care plans entirely
options.C: To prevent errors when coordinating care across different teams
options.D: To ensure patients never ask questions about their treatment

explanation: Effective communication bridges gaps between various healthcare professionals and departments, safeguarding patient well-being. [learn more](GNS112_U1_T7#GNS112_U1_T7_h4)

question: A nurse gives a concise and structured handover report to the incoming shift before moving to another department. What does this action support?
explanation: Structured handovers ensure that critical patient details are not lost when transferring responsibilities or shifting between units. [learn more](GNS112_U1_T7#GNS112_U1_T7_h4)

question: What role does critical thinking play during emergencies in a busy clinic?

options.A: Helping the nurse prioritize urgent interventions effectively
options.B: Preventing any form of patient anxiety or emotional distress
options.C: Allowing the nurse to ignore hospital protocols completely
options.D: Speeding up the writing of financial audit reports

explanation: Critical thinking helps nurses evaluate competing demands and address the most life-threatening issues first. [learn more](GNS112_U1_T7#GNS112_U1_T7_h5)

question: A nurse who remains calm and finds a safe workaround during a sudden supply shortage demonstrates what skill?
explanation: Finding safe alternatives during unexpected challenges is a core component of effective problem-solving in clinical practice. [learn more](GNS112_U1_T7#GNS112_U1_T7_h5)

question: Why must a polyvalent nurse be especially mindful of their scope of practice?

options.A: Working across multiple units can tempt them to perform unfamiliar tasks
options.B: Legal regulations do not apply to nurses who work in rural clinics
options.C: Doctors are legally responsible for all nursing clinical errors
options.D: Specialized units have no rules regarding patient confidentiality

explanation: Versatility can sometimes lead practitioners into areas where they lack sufficient competence, making strict adherence to scope vital. [learn more](GNS112_U1_T7#GNS112_U1_T7_h6)

question: Which ethical duty remains mandatory for a nurse regardless of the department?
explanation: Confidentiality is a fundamental ethical obligation in all nursing environments and specialties. [learn more](GNS112_U1_T7#GNS112_U1_T7_h6)

question: How does polyvalent nursing directly benefit rural healthcare delivery in Nigeria?

options.A: By providing versatile staff who can handle multiple health needs
options.B: By replacing all traditional birth attendants with medical doctors
options.C: By centralizing all sick patients into large state capital hospitals
options.D: By stopping the migration of health workers to foreign countries

explanation: Rural clinics often have few staff members, so nurses who can perform various clinical duties are invaluable. [learn more](GNS112_U1_T7#GNS112_U1_T7_h7)

question: The main workforce challenge that polyvalent nursing helps address in Nigeria is what?

options.A: Uneven distribution and shortage of clinical personnel
options.B: Lack of interest in healthcare careers among secondary students
options.C: An overabundance of surgical specialists in village clinics
options.D: Excessive funding available for primary healthcare centers

explanation: Versatile nursing roles help bridge the staffing gaps caused by personnel shortages, particularly outside major cities. [learn more](GNS112_U1_T7#GNS112_U1_T7_h7)
